name: v1.0.20 — Fix Recents Clear All & System Tasks
body:
## 🌸 Kids OS v1.0.20 Release Notes

### 🧹 Recents Clear All & System Stack Fixes
- **Fixed Recents Re-populating Bug**: Completely eliminated auto-seeding logic that was mistakenly re-injecting 4 apps into the recents overlay immediately after clearing.
- **Full OS System Task Removal**: Integrated reflection-based `ActivityManager.removeTask()` and `finishAndRemoveTask()` to ensure tasks and background processes are completely eliminated from the device when Clear All Windows is pressed.
- **Individual Dismissal Process Killer**: Swiping or clicking dismiss on individual recent cards now actively terminates the corresponding background process.
- **Stock Recents Interception**: Ensured attempts to trigger raw Android system recents are immediately routed to our kid-safe pastel-pink My Melody recents interface.
